policy_context.approval_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22: independently investigate M4 writer-tail and reader contention with bounded contained workloads; preserve all hard safety checks.
policy_context.execution_authorization_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22 authorizes bounded exploratory M4 measurements and remeasurement after material instrumentation changes, using fresh operation IDs and full containment; no retry after a gate failure and no hard-gate bypass.
policy_context.resource_basis: One distinct same-cap cache-churn profile after direct trie streaming. It stores the first child edge inline in every TrieNode and allocates the unordered map only for additional children, reducing per-node map/bucket/hash-node overhead for the pinned base dictionary's frequent unary nodes. It also makes DeleteUserWord remove/prune the requested term rather than the pre-existing first-rune subtree. The legacy vector-taking Trie constructor remains and both entry paths are tested. Capture cgroup memory.stat, memory.peak, analyzer init times and PSS; compare descriptively with memory_churn_two_versions_trie_stream. Single-run multi-change exploratory evidence only, not causal proof, stable latency/memory, capacity or architecture qualification. Any preflight/runtime/containment failure consumes the profile and is not retried.
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Each four-arm exploratory operation is descriptive only; shared-host pressure, one round per arm and test-scale workloads prohibit causal, qualification or architecture-win claims. ApplyBatch and Upsert call latencies have different units and must not be compared as equivalent tail samples.
